nodes.label: Idea Scout Skill
nodes.rationale: Scans the processed knowledge commons for gap language ('there is no...', 'missing...') and repeated themes, then evaluates novelty/relevance/feasibility/evidence/impact before surfacing, so ideas are evidence-backed and never duplicate existing projects.

nodes.label: Idea Lifecycle (surfaced → hatched)
nodes.rationale: Stages surfaced → proposed → approved → developing → hatched → archived map escalating human commitment (agent → community champion → council → developers → independent repo), keeping agent-detected ideas gated behind human review before resources are committed.
